_doc: Hand-added events — the flyer channel. These merge into the scraped feed on every scrape via scrapers/manual.js, so they survive rebuilds. Verify against the organizer's own announcement before adding (never from a flyer alone unless the flyer IS the organizer's). Same fields as scraped events; id auto-built from date+title. Past events are dropped automatically; prune this file occasionally.

events.title: MNI House Picnic with Tricky Miki
